regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, one-narrative regime: Banks are the sole eligible leader with a high durability bar (0.8) and full breadth (1.0), while only 2 of 22 themes clear the absolute-trend gate. Critically, gate_helps is false here — on China A-shares history the trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown — and relative momentum is classed as ~non-predictive (attention lens). Directional accuracy on my past calls is 0.377, so I keep conviction low and treat the whole read as a conditional, not a forecast.
emerging_watch: Banks remain the sole eligible leader, but crowding_z 1.84 with one_narrative=true and absorption 0.33 means leadership is extended and fully discovered — the watch is for breadth contraction: if Banks' breadth drops below 0.7 while Coal's breadth rises above 0.5, the one-narrative structure is cracking and the Banks overweight leg should be retired.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only fully-eligible theme with a trending (hurst=trend) durability bar of 0.8 and breadth of 1.0 — full participation, not a narrow 1-2 name move. In a mean-reverting tape where the gate has shown no drawdown-control edge (gate_helps false), the durability leg is the more relevant coincident signal: leadership is still cohesive and unbroken. I lean with it, not because rank predicts returns.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.84 and crowded=true mean this is a fully discovered, reflexive leadership — the flow is already there and the 2.5% trailing 10-day move is modest; if the A-share tape mean-reverts, an extended crowded leader can churn sideways or give back silently while nothing else clears the gate.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS breaks below its own 20-day low while Banks are still the top-ranked theme.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only other gate-eligible theme and shows decent mean-revert texture (hurst=mean-revert, score 0.965) but weak breadth (0.4) — participation is narrow and the durability bar is only 0.5. In a market where the gate has no verified drawdown edge, the mean-revert tag is a caution: the path that gets you there is whippy, and half the constituent breadth is absent. I lean against it as a paired down-leg to the Banks up-leg, not as a standalone short.
theses.dissent: If A-shares do trend for a stretch (contrary to the gate_helps false history), Coal is the only non-Bank theme that clears the absolute-trend gate and would be the natural beneficiary of any rotation out of crowded Banks.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS makes a new 20-day high while its breadth fraction rises above 0.6.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
